label: replay_fixture
description: The GraphHopper sidecar is unreachable or times out. This is not a graph/band property; it is a router-availability scenario. Per ARCHITECTURE.md section 11 and CONTRACTS.md, the adapter must return a labelled, deterministic degraded result and never an unlabelled cached route.

expected.notes: route_feasible is explicitly null (not false) because unavailability is not a hard-constraint exclusion; it is a router failure. The distinction matters: a null/unavailable result must never be interpreted as 'no feasible route' or cached and served as if verified.

implementation_note: This fixture proves a deterministic fixture path exists for router outage per B-M0-01 acceptance criteria. Implementing the actual GraphHopper adapter and its timeout/retry behavior is B-M1-02 scope, not B-M0-01.
